en: The image shows a black and white photograph of a parade or public celebration, possibly from the mid-20th century. Several women in traditional or rural dress are walking in front of a decorated float or banner, which features the Cyrillic text 'Жетва въ боляри.' A group of people, likely participants in the event, are holding up additional signs with Cyrillic text. The background displays a city street scene with period architecture and a shop sign also in Cyrillic.
